label: HISTORICAL DEMO
description: Real NASA FIRMS active-fire detections, bundled unmodified as an offline demo dataset. Not live: observations are from the acquisition window below.
product: SUOMI_VIIRS_C2 (VIIRS 375 m active fire, Collection 2, NRT)
coverageFile: USA contiguous and Hawaii, last 7 days
subset: Rows inside the California bounding box west=-124.5 south=32.5 east=-114.0 north=42.0 (includes border strips of neighbouring states and Baja California)
notes: The public FIRMS CSV has no `instrument` column; VIIRS is the product's instrument, carried into each observation from this descriptor, not measured per row.
No values were edited, filled or derived. Fields absent from the source stay null and display as N/A.
credit: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), LANCE/EOSDIS. We acknowledge the use of data from NASA's FIRMS, part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
